prompt.generated_prompt_string: An intimate but non-explicit fashion portrait of a clearly adult woman on a bed, leaning forward toward the camera with a calm soft gaze and faint smile, dewy natural skin highlights, and quiet private bedroom mood. She has dark brown to black hair in a sleek low bun with a few intentional wispy face-framing strands, gentle slightly sleepy direct eye contact, natural glass-skin-inspired makeup, soft taupe-brown liner, straight brows, glossy nude-pink lips, and realistic moisturized skin texture. She wears a fully opaque-lined beige or nude luxury lace balconette fashion set with fine floral texture, clean premium stitching, delicate straps, and no logos. Her hands support her on the rumpled mattress, torso angled forward with a slight head tilt. Set the scene in a minimal bedroom with cool gray-to-off-white walls, simple closet or door panels, and soft out-of-focus bedding. Use single soft window light from camera-left at approximately 6000K with dim cool ambient fill, a vertical 9:16 three-quarter crop, realistic candid fashion detail, mild low-light softness, subtle noise, and lived-in imperfections. Keep the mood tender, editorial, and non-sexual with no nudity or exposed intimate areas.
